test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on function arguments to verify child objects are kept alive
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify returned child objects stay alive
test_alive_gc: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy with garbage collection on circular references
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to verify child objects are kept alive
test_call_guard: test the pybind11 call_guard policy to verify guarded and unguarded function calls
